title: Mike Johnson, “isn’t this your job?”
summary: Speaker Mike Johnson lashed out at a reporter, calling him “stupid” for asking about Johnson’s culpability in the Iran War. Jessica Tarlov and Aaron Parnas discuss, on Raging Perspective.
transcript_html:
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/PHNHabxOjKM

Transcript

On Iran, you said repeatedly that this war was going to be over soon. You said that this would be a temporary blip on short term on gas prices. It is still more than six months. People are getting hurt still at the pump. Should the American people not also judge you on your projections here that were clearly off base? >> I don't know who that is. It's one of the stupidest questions you've ever asked. >> Why is that so stupid? >> I have nothing to do with the prosecution of the war across the globe. >> Uh-oh. >> But they're so rude. >> That's not Southern hospitality. >> The idea that the speaker of the house shouldn't be held responsible for any of

the comments that he makes, which are supposed to be rooted in things like briefings and relationships with the people in the administration up to the president, who he definitely has on speed dial, is ludicrous. >> Isn't it in Congress's job to approve a war? >> We're forgetting that that is what Congress's job is is to have oversight over war.
